name: Final Boss #0
description:
Final Boss is a Sci-fi electronic composition created with modular synthesis and digital elements to bring back the 90's nostalgia of video games.

That moment when you get to the last stage and need to play over and over till you  beat the "Final Boss", is a major memory for anyone that lived through the 90's.

This is also another proof that vintage sounds and new technology can work side by side.

Collecting this Genesis Async Music Blueprint, will hopefully take you into a special and intimate journey.

signatures.message: I, Leonardo Cruz have issued an Async Art Blueprint "Final Boss" on contract address 0x71925638b9998ab631c83873d9ed19ef9b70ecf0 with an edition count of 200.
